title: Dill and Pickle Dumplings
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dumpling dish that combines the freshness of dill with the tanginess of pickle, creating a delightful twist on traditional dumplings.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped dill and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced pickles and cook for 2-3 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the dumplings to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil, minced garlic, and cook for 1 minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, and serve hot.
